description: This file defines the DepositProductRecurringDetail class, representing the recurring detail configuration for a deposit product in the savings domain. It manages the relationship to the associated product and provides methods to update and access deposit recurring details.

classes.name: DepositProductRecurringDetail
classes.description: Entity class representing detailed recurring deposit product information, linked to a savings product and containing methods to create, update, and access its recurring detail.

methods.name: createNew
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new instance of DepositProductRecurringDetail with specified details and product.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the recurring detail using data from a JsonCommand; returns the map of changes applied.

methods.name: recurringDetail
methods.description: Accessor method to retrieve the embedded DepositRecurringDetail.

methods.name: updateProductReference
methods.description: Updates the associated product reference with a new SavingsProduct, cast to RecurringDepositProduct.
